engine.notes: San Francisco's scene is anchored by BATS at Fort Mason and the Mission's Endgames, with Leela and Secret Improv Society downtown. Un-Scripted Theater Company, founded 2002 at 533 Sutter, has not resumed a regular season and now produces the Bay Area Musical Improv Festival in Oakland; Oakland's All Out Comedy Theater and Pan Theater sit just outside this page. entries.name: BATS Improv
entries.summary: San Francisco's largest and oldest improv theater, founded 1986 in the Keith Johnstone tradition, with its own Bayfront Theatre at Fort Mason, six Foundation levels and a Saturday season of Theatresports and improvised plays.
entries.schedule: Shows Saturdays with extra nights for special runs; Theatresports Saturdays in November; workshops October 3 to 4
signals: Own theatre at Fort Mason Center
Six Foundation levels ending in a performance showcase
Weekly Saturday shows plus seasonal runs
entries.reasons: Forty years, a theatre of its own, a six-level school and a dated season through December; only the one-night-a-week core schedule keeps it short of a perfect show score.

entries.name: Endgames Improv
entries.summary: A long-form improv theater and training center with two Mission Street studios, a five-level curriculum from imp101 to imp501 in seven-week terms, Friday house shows running since 2011 and a free Sunday jam open to all levels.
entries.schedule: Fridays 9pm and 10:15pm house shows; free ETC Jam Sundays 6pm; seven-week classes start monthly
signals: Five improv levels plus sketch, $399 per seven weeks
Your Fucked Up Relationship every Friday since 2011
Free graduation shows for each level
entries.reasons: A complete ladder from first class to house team, weekly shows and a free jam in rooms of its own; smaller and younger than BATS, which is the only gap.

entries.name: Leela Improv Theatre
entries.summary: A long-form improv school and theatre on Geary Street founded 2003, with Improv 1 to 5, a four-level musical improv track, weekly drop-ins, an eleven-week performing ensemble program and $10 community jams every other Friday.
entries.schedule: Community jams Fridays 7:30 to 9:30pm, every other week; drop-in classes weekly
signals: Space of its own at 450 Geary Street
Improv 1 to 5 plus musical improv 1 to 4
entries.reasons: Two decades, a room of its own, the deepest class catalogue in the city and a standing jam, held back by a show calendar that is mostly student and ensemble nights.

entries.name: Secret Improv Society
entries.summary: A weekly improv comedy show at the Shelton Theater on Sutter Street, playing Friday and Saturday nights with showcase and residency shows on select Sundays, backed by a four-tier training programme.
signals: Resident at the Shelton Theater, 533 Sutter Street
Four-tier training: Foundations, Characters, Narrative, Advanced
entries.reasons: A reliable twice-weekly show in a permanent theatre and a four-step class path, but the site publishes no term dates or history.

entries.name: Berkeley Rep School of Theatre
entries.summary: The education arm of Berkeley Repertory Theatre runs a three-step adult improv track, Beginning, Intermediate and an Advanced Performance Lab, in evening sessions at its Addison Street school each quarter.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026: Beginning Improv Thursdays from September 24, Intermediate Mondays from September 28, Advanced Lab Tuesdays
signals: Part of a Tony-winning regional theatre
entries.reasons: A permanent institution with a dated, three-level improv track, but no improv shows and a programme that stops at the lab level.

entries.name: Moment Improv Theatre
entries.summary: A Black-owned, community-built improv theatre that teaches a nine-level curriculum almost entirely online, with $5 Friday drop-ins, occasional Bay Area intensives, and pop-up shows and community jams in San Francisco.
entries.schedule: Online classes year-round; $5 Friday drop-ins; Bay Area intensives occasionally
signals: Nine-level online curriculum in three tiers
entries.reasons: A structured curriculum and current programming, but almost entirely online, without a venue or a regular in-person show.
